rationale: The exact v18 catalog includes all 49 candidate pairs accepted in my signed quality review, across 27 affected boards, with no diagnostic or competing-output drop. I verified all 68 archived source records against the current pack, their core fingerprints and concept labels, and replayed every retained core route to its target. For the 27 catalog entries, the seeds, target, category, full core recipes, routes and par remain exact; each entry and core fingerprint recomputes correctly. Each addition preserves its reviewed candidate fingerprint, uses a previously absent sorted pair entirely inside the original concept set, produces an existing nonseed core result, and keeps the target out of the inputs. The required two directed supporting edges are non-distractors of strength at least 0.70 and match the archived and current KG provenance. I independently searched both original and augmented recipe maps through six actions: every original optimum and par is preserved. All resulting choices remain within the existing 24-pair and 32-concept limits, preserve the maximum four stored routes and six steps per route, and introduce no node, seed, target or core-output replacement. Every proposal node and edge snapshot matches the current graph. The native audit binds this catalog and candidate and records 27 board/49 addition replays, unchanged cores/routes/par and preserved graph provenance. All nine actual source bindings and all 155 runtime digests match, including the three native auditors. No quality, progression or bounded-choice blocker remains; installed checks and exact-SHA qualification remain separate required gates.
